key.name: switchinterval
key.description: Time - in seconds - between wallpaper changes

key.name: runwallstreet
key.description: Whether WallStreet should run. When ticked, WallStreet also autostarts on logon

key.name: random
key.description: Whether to use random wallpapers from the set directory or not

key.name: lockscreensync
key.description: Whether WallStreet should also set the wallpaper for lockscreen

key.name: wallpaperfolder
key.description: The default folder that WallStreet should use to find the wallpapers

key.name: fallbackwallpaper
key.summary: The backround to set in case of an errors
key.description: In case there are no files in the used folder, a fallback image will be used

key.name: timeofday-enabled
key.description: Whether to use separate day and night wallpapers

key.name: daytime-wallpaper
key.description: Wallpaper to use during daytime hours

key.name: nighttime-wallpaper
key.description: Wallpaper to use during nighttime hours

key.name: potd-wikipedia-enabled
key.summary: Fetch Wikipedia picture of the day
key.description: Whether to download the daily featured image from Wikipedia

key.name: potd-bing-enabled
key.summary: Fetch Bing picture of the day
key.description: Whether to download the daily Bing homepage image

key.name: potd-folder-name
key.summary: Picture of the day folder name
key.description: Name of the subfolder, created inside the user's Pictures folder, that downloaded pictures of the day are stored in

key.name: potd-wikipedia-last-fetch
key.summary: Last Wikipedia picture of the day fetch date
key.description: Internal bookkeeping: the date (YYYY-MM-DD) the Wikipedia picture of the day was last downloaded, used to avoid re-fetching more than once a day

key.name: potd-bing-last-fetch
key.summary: Last Bing picture of the day fetch date
key.description: Internal bookkeeping: the date (YYYY-MM-DD) the Bing picture of the day was last downloaded, used to avoid re-fetching more than once a day
